logp.method_description: The octanol/water partition coefficient of [67Cu]Cu(II)–N-(2- pyridylmethyl)-N9-(salicylaldimino)-1,3-propanediamine was measured following 1 min of vigorous vortex mixing of 2 mL of 1-octanol and 2 mL of isotonic Tris-buffered saline (pH 7.4) (3), with approximately 0.3 mCi of the radiolabeled copper complex. From this initial partitioning, 500 mL of the octanol phase was repartitioned two times with 1 mL of fresh 1-octanol and 2 mL of fresh buffer. The partition coefficients, P, are reported as counts per gram of octanol divided by counts per gram of aqueous phase. The reported octanol/water partition coefficients represent the mean (6 standard deviation) of six measurements.
